terms.comment: Recorded in Morgan–Owens with botanical and modern lexical references. lycopersicum is a learned botanical formation. Scientific plant name: Solanum lycopersicum.
An attested competing Neo-Latin form, cited in Morgan–Owens through Helfer. The tomāta family ultimately reflects Nahuatl through Spanish.
Not preferred here. The earlier assertion that scholarship had specifically discredited it has been removed: a preference is not proof that a competing form is wrong.
